subject: Restrict zmadvise_dontneed_range() to jemalloc builds (#3791)
reason: The change only narrows a preprocessor condition so madvise(MADV_DONTNEED) in zmadvise_dontneed_range() compiles on jemalloc Linux builds instead of all Linux builds. Its sole caller, dismissRehashedBucketsIfNeeded() in hashtable.c, releases pages of already-rehashed, dead hashtable buckets back to the OS during rehashing. On the default jemalloc build the compiled code is identical before and after the change; on non-jemalloc builds the only effect is that those dead pages are no longer released, which changes RSS but no command reply, stored data, replication, failover, or persistence behavi
